entries.title: Ephesians 1:1
segments: ¶Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, To the saints who are in Ephesus, and faithful in Christ Jesus:

entries.title: Ephesians 1:2
segments: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Ephesians 1:3
segments: ¶Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly [places] in Christ,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:4
segments: just as He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before Him in love,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:5
segments: having predestined us to adoption as sons by Jesus Christ to Himself, according to the good pleasure of His will,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:6
segments: to the praise of the glory of His grace, by which He has made us accepted in the Beloved.

entries.title: Ephesians 1:7
segments: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of His grace

entries.title: Ephesians 1:8
segments: which He made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:9
segments: having made known to us the mystery of His will, according to His good pleasure which He purposed in Himself,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:10
segments: that in the dispensation of the fullness of the times He might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven and which are on earth--in Him.

entries.title: Ephesians 1:11
segments: In Him also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestined according to the purpose of Him who works all things according to the counsel of His will,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:12
segments: that we who first trusted in Christ should be to the praise of His glory.

entries.title: Ephesians 1:13
segments: In Him you also [trusted], after you heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation; in whom also, having believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:14
segments: who is the guarantee of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, to the praise of His glory.

entries.title: Ephesians 1:15
segments: ¶Therefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:16
segments: do not cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers:

entries.title: Ephesians 1:17
segments: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of Him,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:18
segments: the eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that you may know what is the hope of His calling, what are the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the saints,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:19
segments: and what [is] the exceeding greatness of His power toward us who believe, according to the working of His mighty power

entries.title: Ephesians 1:20
segments: which He worked in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated [Him] at His right hand in the heavenly [places],

entries.title: Ephesians 1:21
segments: far above all principality and power and might and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age but also in that which is to come.

entries.title: Ephesians 1:22
segments: And He put all [things] under His feet, and gave Him [to be] head over all [things] to the church,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:23
segments: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.
